label: Secret Jutsu - Thieves of Justice: B

lines.text: *Cough, cough!*
The thick smoke clears, and as I lift my head...
Huh...? Wh-what's this?
The hallway is packed with countless Deltas.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Ninjutsu:

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Hologram Clone!

lines.speaker: pickpocket
lines.text: Wh-what the...!?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: The grenade you just threw was no ordinary one.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Now that my clones are blocking the path, you will not be able to escape easily.

lines.speaker: pickpocket
lines.text: You've gotta be kidding me...

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I've got a question!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: If they're just holograms, then you can just walk right through them, right?

lines.speaker: pickpocket
lines.text: Wait...

lines.speaker: pickpocket
lines.text: Y-you're right!

lines.speaker: pickpocket
lines.text: Ah, geez! I got scared for no reason! Hahaha!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: ... You've discovered the flaw in this jutsu. Well done.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Wait a moment,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: are you the trainee ninja thief?!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: That is correct.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Del—no, Trainee Ninja Thief!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Let's join forces to catch that pickpocket, reclaim the items, and then make our exit.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: After all, that's what it means to be a phantom thief!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I apologize.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I wish to prove that I can accomplish this on my own,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: so that I can officially join the Thieves of Justice!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Hyaaah!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: What...?!
Delta tries to throw a shuriken at the pickpocket,
but her holographic clones block her vision, and she can't see a thing.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Can't you dismiss your clones, Trainee Ninja Thief?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: That cannot be done...
But we can't even see a thing.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Do not worry. I shall apprehend him myself.
Delta runs in the other direction.
*Tap tap tap*
Taking advantage of the poor visibility, the pickpocket charges straight at us.
He's trying to make a run for the door behind us!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Ahhh! I can't see a thing!
*Bump*

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Kyaa!

lines.speaker: pickpocket
lines.text: Urgh!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Wow, you just bump into me and don't even say sorry?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Quency, are you okay?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: As I thought, Miranda's the only one who cares about me.
As she says so, she winks at me.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Go after that pickpocket, Quiry!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: O-okay!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I'll follow his footsteps!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Miranda, keep watch at the doorway.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Got it!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I'll be arresting the Thieves of Justice and the trainee ninja thief too!
Poli slowly approaches us.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Th-this can't be...

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: In the end, I let him slip away...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Trainee Ninja Thief,

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: the items have already been retrieved. You need not worry.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Is that really the case?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I'm pretty dexterous myself.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Snagged it when we bumped into each other earlier, hehe.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: That's why we deliberately stood all together in one corner.
I was just standing there without thinking... When did that plan even start?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Even Miranda blocking the door was really meant to give us a chance to escape.
No way...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: The Thieves of Justice are not just one person.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It is all of us together.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: The mission is a success, so it is best we return now.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: In that case,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I shall clear the path for you.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: What in the world?!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Someone has to hold Poli back.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I shall draw her attention to allow everyone to escape unharmed!
Delta holds out a hand.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Wh-what's this?!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I control my energy, gather it at my fingertips, and make it spin.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Then I compress it and spin it faster... to amplify its power...!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Haaah...!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Hyaaaah!!!!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: ... Watcha doing?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I don't see anything.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Darn it...!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Am I still unfit to use this jutsu...?
Just then...
One after another, the Thieves of Justice come forward and place their hands on Delta's.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: If one person's energy is insufficient, we shall lend our aid!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Gather your energy at your fingertips!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: And make it spin really fast!!
Ugh, I really don't want to do this...
Hyaaaah!! Take this!!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Everyone...

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: ... I can sense tremendous power!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: So this is... the power of the Thieves of Justice?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Very well. With everyone's strength gathered,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I shall give this jutsu a new name!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Hyaaah! Brace yourselves for my final strike!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Secret Jutsu: Thieves of Justice, Spiral—

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Thieves of Justice, withdraw!
We grab Delta's hand
and bolt straight out of the house.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: that was just to draw my attention so they can escape?!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Grrrr...

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Grrrrrr!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: And why did Miranda have to go running off with them toooo!!

lines.speaker: quiry_op
lines.text: Poli, I caught him!

lines.speaker: quiry_op
lines.text: From what he's saying, he really is a pickpocket,

lines.speaker: quiry_op
lines.text: but he claims the stuff he took out of the bag isn't there. And he keeps yelling for us to

lines.speaker: quiry_op
lines.text: catch the phantom thief...

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Good work. I'll be there soon.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: What should I do about

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: the Thieves of Justice...?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Good work out there, everyone.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: The recovered items were safely returned to their owners, and it seems the pickpocket was taken away by the police.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Heehee, that was so much fun!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: As I expected, the A.C.P.U. is impressive!
Are you gonna be okay, Miranda?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: No worries! I'll put my all into writing the disciplinary report!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Did Delta pass today's test?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Is she really going to join the Thieves of Justice for real?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Ahem.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Very well, I shall announce the results.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: There is no need for undue nervousness.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: You have passed—

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I wish to remain a trainee.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Why is that?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: It is only today do I realize that

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I am still far from ready and require more training.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Since I do not yet truly understand the power of comrades, it is right for me to remain as a trainee.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Delta, if that's how you feel, then it can't be helped.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: *Sigh* My dream of filling our base with phantom thieves is—
What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Therefore,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I would be grateful if you continued to take me along as a trainee.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I shall assist you to the best of my ability.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Then, does this mean you intend to join the Thieves of Justice?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Affirmative.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: So the five of us may actually carry out phantom thief missions together?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I am very pleased.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: What are your thoughts?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Heck yeah! It's fun, so I'm all for it!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Sounds great to me! The more people upholding justice out there, the better!
I don't really care anymore.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Then it is unanimous!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I entrust you to our cause.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I hereby officially pronounce you the trainee ninja thief of the Thieves of Justice!

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I shall learn as much as possible.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: What a beautiful night!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: The night is always beautiful!
I guess I'd better go to bed.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: In that case!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: The Thieves of Justice shall disband here for today.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Everyone, take care!
As the shadows recede, the world begins to stir from its slumber.
Those who once danced beneath the stars slip back to their rightful places.
As though nothing ever occurred, the day begins anew.
And now five in number, the Thieves of Justice
await the day they will come together once more.
GO! NINJA THIEF!: END
